Legal.ImprintSoftwareBody: This instance runs OpenAvisio, an open-source software (AGPL-3.0). The operator of this installation is the controller of the data processed, not the developers of the software.
Legal.ImprintPrivacyBodyBefore: Information on how your data is processed can be found in the
Legal.PrivacyS1Body: The controller, under the LGPD, of this OpenAvisio installation is:
Legal.PrivacyS2Heading: 2. Purposes and legal bases of processing
Legal.PrivacyS2Body: OpenAvisio processes personal data and sensitive personal data (health data, art. 11 of the LGPD) for the following purposes:
Legal.PrivacyS2Item1Body: Storage and processing of medical documents and clinical data. Legal basis: art. 11, II, item “f”, of the LGPD (health protection) or art. 11, I, of the LGPD (specific consent).
Legal.PrivacyS2Item2Body: Authentication and access management. Legal basis: art. 7, V, of the LGPD (performance of a contract).
Legal.PrivacyS2Item3Body: Automatic extraction of structured data from uploaded documents. Legal basis: art. 11, II, item “f”, or art. 11, I, of the LGPD.
Legal.PrivacyS2Item4Body: Traceability of data changes. Legal basis: art. 7, II, of the LGPD (compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation).
Legal.PrivacyS3Item1: User master data: name, email address, role
Legal.PrivacyS3Item2: Authentication data: hashed passwords, passkey credentials
Legal.PrivacyS3Item3: Patient data: name, date of birth, sex
Legal.PrivacyS3Item4: Health data (art. 11 of the LGPD): diagnoses, medications, measurements, lab results, incidents, events, health diary, recommendations
Legal.PrivacyS3Item5: Medical documents: uploaded PDFs and images
Legal.PrivacyS3Item6: Log data: actions in the system with timestamp and user reference
Legal.PrivacyS4Body: Patient data is shared exclusively with users who have been expressly granted access by the responsible user (coordinator or owner). In principle, no data is shared with third parties, unless:
Legal.PrivacyS4Item1: The configured email service provider receives the email address of an invited user for the purpose of sending the invitation.
Legal.PrivacyS4Item2: If AI_BACKEND=mistral is configured: Mistral AI SAS (Paris, France) receives the extracted document text for AI processing. In this case a data processing agreement must be concluded — a template is included with the software (docs/avv-vorlage.md).
Legal.PrivacyUmamiBody: This installation uses the self-hosted analytics software Umami ({url}) to statistically evaluate how the site is used. Umami sets no cookies, creates no user profiles and does not store IP addresses; only anonymised, aggregated access data is collected (pages visited, browser type, country of origin). The data does not leave the operator's server. The legal basis is art. 7, IX, of the LGPD (legitimate interest in audience measurement); a consent banner is not required given the absence of cookies and profiling.
Legal.PrivacyS5Item1: Patient data: until deletion by a coordinator or the responsible user (right to erasure, art. 18 of the LGPD)
Legal.PrivacyS5Item2: User data: until the user account is deleted
Legal.PrivacyS5Item4: Session tokens: 15 minutes (access token), 7 days (refresh token)
Legal.PrivacyS6Body: You have the following rights before the controller:
Legal.PrivacyS6Item1Title: Confirmation and access (art. 18, I and II, of the LGPD)
Legal.PrivacyS6Item1Body: You may request a complete copy of your stored data at any time (FHIR export available).
Legal.PrivacyS6Item2Body: You may have incorrect data corrected.
Legal.PrivacyS6Item3Title: Anonymisation, blocking or deletion (art. 18, IV, of the LGPD)
Legal.PrivacyS6Item3Body: You may demand the complete and irreversible deletion of all your data.
Legal.PrivacyS6Item4Body: You may receive your data in a machine-readable format (FHIR R4 JSON).
Legal.PrivacyS6Item5Title: Information about data sharing (art. 18, VII, of the LGPD)
Legal.PrivacyS6Item5Body: Under certain conditions you may request the restriction of processing.
Legal.PrivacyS6Item6Title: Revocation of consent (art. 18, IX, of the LGPD)
Legal.PrivacyS6Item6Body: You may object to the processing of your data.
Legal.PrivacyS7Body: You have the right to petition against the controller before the national data protection authority:
Legal.PrivacyS7AuthorityName: Agência Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD)
Legal.PrivacyS7AuthorityAddress: SCN, Qd. 6, Conj. A, Ed. Venâncio 3000, Bl. A, 9º andar, Brasília/DF — CEP 70716-900
Legal.PrivacyS8Body: All documents are stored encrypted (AES-GCM with an individual key per document). Transmission takes place exclusively over HTTPS. Access to patient data is limited to expressly authorised users. All data changes are logged.
